decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several specialized options including hydration packs (prod_backpacks_150), cooler backpacks (prod_backpacks_154), and waterproof dry bags (prod_backpacks_174). I ultimately selected the SHENHU 40L Hiking Backpack (prod_backpacks_111) as my final choice. It offers the best overall utility for a general-purpose outdoor pack, featuring a significant 40L capacity, practical hiking features like trekking pole attachments, and positive reviews regarding its chest and torso support. At $26.99, it provides the best balance of value and features compared to more niche options like the TRANSPACK ski bag or the specialized hydration reservoirs.
